blocking_counterexample.title: Three-state rollback witness reintroduces future-determinant pre-binding
blocking_counterexample.construction: Before the first promotion, construct SemanticDeterminantGraph authority edges from old_model, v2_ref and v3_ref to the same replaced/noncurrent/downstream product refs.
blocking_counterexample.violation: Products are thereby declared dependent on future revisions they have not consumed. Accepted C1-03R registration law permits only actually consumed determinant authorities and introduces revisions through governed transitions.
blocking_counterexample.why_load_bearing: With the lawful old_model-only graph used by the accepted promotion fixture, the later v2->v3 transition cannot reach the original product refs; the static owner graph does not dynamically register the replacement products under v2. Future pre-binding is what makes the second A non-empty.
blocking_counterexample.required_behavior: Produce a genuinely mixed rollback with time-lawful consumed-determinant registrations, or return the bounded owner/registration gap if the current static graph cannot express it.
